                       SOAH ORDER NO. 32
                ADDRESSING POST-HEARING MATTERS

      The hearing on the merits convened June 8-12, 2026. Before adjourning, the
Administrative Law Judges (ALJs) discussed requirements for post-hearing briefs
and submissions and memorialize them here.
 I.     POST-HEARING BRIEFS

       SOAH Order No. 6 set the parties’ deadlines for post-hearing briefs:
          • Initial briefs are due on June 19, 2026; and
          • Reply briefs and Proposed Findings of Fact, Conclusions of Law, and
              Ordering Paragraphs are due June 26, 2026.


       All briefs must be filed on the Commission’s Interchange. Briefs filed before
midnight on the filing deadline will be considered timely filed. Applicants are
required to file, and any other party may file, Proposed Findings of Fact, Conclusions
of Law, and Ordering Paragraphs. Word versions of the parties’ Proposed Findings
of Fact, Conclusions of Law, and Ordering Paragraphs may additionally be emailed
to rhonda.faught@soah.texas.gov.


       Closing briefs are optional. You may file both an initial brief and a reply brief;
you may file just an initial brief; you may choose to forego an initial brief and simply
reply to other parties’ initial briefs; or you can elect not to file a brief at all. If you had
evidence admitted during the hearing, it will be considered by the ALJs even if you
do not file a brief. Conversely, if you were admitted as an intervenor, you may file a
closing brief even if you did not have any exhibits admitted.


       All evidence to be considered in this case was admitted at the hearing, either
through written testimony and other documents that were admitted as exhibits or
through live testimony taken during the hearing. No new information can be
introduced in written closing briefs. The parties’ briefs should cite to specific

                                               2
                                     SOAH Order No. 32
                       SOAH Docket No. 473-26-16349, PUC Docket No. 59475
 exhibits or testimony they believe support their arguments, and provide page
numbers where relevant.


II.      POST-HEARING ADMITTED EXHIBITS 1

         No later than the second business day following the conclusion of the
hearing, the parties shall confer and arrange the admitted, record set of exhibits. All
exhibits should be readily identifiable by specific folder. A party’s failure to timely
include its exhibits in the record set may result in submission of an incomplete record
to the Commission.


         No later than the third business day following conclusion of the hearing, the
parties shall submit the final, record set of exhibits in electronic format to the court-
reporting service. This submission shall contain all exhibits that were admitted as
evidence or accompanied by an offer of proof. This set of exhibits will constitute the
“record set” that SOAH will send to the Commission when SOAH’s involvement
has concluded.




1 These deadlines were extended by one business day from SOAH Order No. 6 because the court reporting service

will provide the admitted exhibit list to Applicants no later than the first business day following the conclusion of the
hearing. That exhibit list will be used to compile the admitted, record set of exhibits.
